item.title: Iran ceasefire deal gives Trump a way out of war - but at a high cost
item.summary: The path to the two-week ceasefire with Iran may have fundamentally altered the way the rest of the world views the US.

item.title: What we know about the two-week ceasefire between the US and Iran
item.summary: The provisional truce comes more than a month after the US and Israel launched coordinated attacks on Iran.

item.title: Israel strikes southern Lebanon after US-Iran ceasefire
item.summary: Air strikes hit the Tyre and Nabatieh areas hours after the US-Iran ceasefire was announced.

item.title: Oil prices plunge and shares jump on US-Iran ceasefire plan
item.summary: Crude prices tumbled by as much as 15% on the conditional pause but remain far higher than before the war.

item.title: One gunman killed and two injured in shooting at Israeli consulate in Istanbul
item.summary: No Israeli diplomats are currently in Turkey and the Istanbul consulate has been empty for the past two-and-a-half years.

item.title: WHO suspends Gaza medical evacuations after contractor killed by Israeli troops
item.summary: Israel's military says troops fired at a vehicle driven by the Palestinian because they believed it posed "an immediate threat".

item.title: Newlywed wife of US soldier freed by ICE after detention at military base
item.summary: Annie Ramos, an undocumented immigrant who came to the US as a toddler, had gone to the base to complete paperwork so the couple could move in together.

item.title: French couple leave Iran after more than three years in jail
item.summary: Cecile Kohler and Jacques Paris are on their way home after being allowed to leave the country, the French president says.

item.title: Man fined after breaking into viral hippo Moo Deng's enclosure
item.summary: The director of the Thai zoo where Moo Deng lives said security would be upped after the incident.

item.title: Top Australian soldier charged with war crimes to remain in jail on remand
